title: Comprehensive
text: My wife and I did the full day, private tour of the Albaicin and Alhambra.  Our guide Jacqueline was excellent, very knowledgeable, well organized and moved us through the day efficiently.   We thoroughly enjoyed her company and benefited greatly from her insights.  A day well spent.  Administratively, Pancho Tours was a bit disorganized.  In booking the tour, Pancho sent us the same emails numerous times, not a problem but it did fill up the inbox.  Also the company sent us the wrong meeting spot to begin the tour.  Fortunately the company contacted us with the correct information, and we did
author: John H

title: Excellent tour - Pedro was a great guide
text: We booked this tour with Pancho because we had left it too late to get tickets for the Alhambra through their official website.  We are very glad that we did as we had a very special walk through the Albaicin with Pedro (my husband and I were the only members of the tour group) before our visit to the Alhambra.  Pedro was an excellent guide - friendly, courteous and knowledgeable.  Our skip-the-line tickets to the Alhambra were great - no waiting.
author: HappyBCTravellers
